skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand and apply basic concepts of web architecture and web services.
Design and implement the architecture, interface, and database of a website.
Style and format web pages using CSS.
Apply object-oriented programming principles in web development.
Develop web applications using languages such as C#, Java, JavaScript, or PHP.
Connect and interact with databases in web applications.
Implement and use web services in web applications.
Understand and apply the Model-View-Controller (MVC) architecture in web development.
Manage and coordinate resources, evaluate and improve the efficiency of web development activities.
Demonstrate self-reliance and responsibility in independent learning and teamwork.
Express and defend personal viewpoints based on objective and scientific approaches.
Demonstrate social responsibility and professional ethics in web development.
